title: Masked Autoencoder (MAE)
reading: The slide introduces the Masked Autoencoder (MAE) and notes that images are split into patches which serve as visual tokens, following the Vision Transformer formulation. The text is terse: no mechanism, loss, or masking ratio is given here, only the framing that MAE operates over patch tokens rather than pixels directly.

concepts.name: Masked Autoencoder (MAE)
concepts.why_it_matters: Self-supervised pretraining approach that reconstructs masked image regions.

concepts.name: Patches as visual tokens
concepts.why_it_matters: Turns an image into a token sequence so transformer machinery applies.

concepts.name: Vision Transformer
concepts.why_it_matters: Provides the patch-embedding backbone MAE builds on.
